title: Stages of sale
kicker: How to start doing sales · the stages
caption: The first two steps are in your hands. After them, every stage pushes the money further to the right.

generation.title: Lead generation
generation.text: Research and keep a list of potential customers

agreement.title: Signed contract
agreement.text: The customer agrees to a contractual and transactional relationship

cash.title: Invoice paid
cash.text: 30 to 60 days after it is sent

cash-waits-on-paperwork.description: With no contract term, interest on a late B2B payment starts only 30 days after the invoice is received, contract terms may run up to 60 days, and an acceptance step can add up to 30 more days before the clock starts. This is an EU directive; other jurisdictions differ.[1]

late-payment-directive.title: European Parliament and Council, Directive 2011/7/EU on combating late payment in commercial transactions

the-lags-add-up.description: The sources show each delay separately: finding customers, closing, invoicing, payment terms. That they add into one lag, which is why the chain must start early, is an inference.[1]

late-payment-directive.title: European Parliament and Council, Directive 2011/7/EU on combating late payment in commercial transactions

leads-step-one.title: Leads, step one
leads-step-one.script: The first step is lead generation. Research and keep a list of potential customers, with names, not a feeling. Start the list this week, and maintain it every week after that.

first-contact-step-two.title: First contact, step two
first-contact-step-two.script: The second step is first contact. Cold call, call back an inbound lead, or ask your network, and pick one of them. Make that first call, because that is what opens opportunities.

opportunities-are-the-work.title: Opportunities are the work
opportunities-are-the-work.script: An opportunity means interest, and interest is not a deal. Follow-up, material, meetings and negotiation are the hard part of sales, and they take calendar time that you cannot compress with willpower.

closing-is-not-cash.title: Closing is not cash
closing-is-not-cash.script: Even a signed contract is not cash. After it come production, delivery and customer success, and only then the invoice, so every stage pushes the money further to the right.
